notes.title: Shining Song Starnova Goes Live on 25/07/2018... Sorta!
notes.content:
Following our [url=https://twitter.com/Love_In_Space/status/1017358776352104448]update on Twitter[/url] we've now decided to go ahead with releasing the game initially via other channels.

[b]These channels will be:[/b]

- GOG
- Denpasoft
- MangaGamer

[b]As of 25/07/2018:[/b]

- JAST USA
- Nutaku

We'll continue to work with Valve once more information is available and remain committed to do everything we can to get a version on Steam but until then the Steam release will remain without a release date.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30019814/fc5c41ccde8b06a59eb6f0e8c5dbbdeeb5dc0a8c.jpg[/img]
